observations: fast.rs call_format_memory selects an outlined method for dynamic FastFormatter options because its own comments report code expansion being slower; it inlines for constant SpecializedFormatter options.
Its numeric formatter uses pair tables and leading-zero digit counts, already investigated in R1150, R1155 and R1158. Repeating that same proposal would discard the existing evidence.
R1472 demonstrates why removing two local memory comparisons is insufficient: surrounding register allocation added more than one million simulated instructions on SSL32.
next: Resolve the frozen iterator layout loss with PMU frontend events and preserve the original controls. Avoid treating source similarity to iced or a shorter C expression as a throughput result.
